operations.name: constrain
operations.help: Attach a snapshot of the whole candidate schema, or a local schema file, under local-2020-12-v1.

operations.name: unconstrain
operations.help: Explicitly detach schema constraints without changing the draft or accepted document.

operations.name: schema
operations.help: Inspect the active schema snapshot, exact text, and interpretation policy.

operations.name: validate
operations.help: Validate a complete candidate or accepted document and report precise findings; drafts remain editable.

operations.name: guide
operations.help: Inspect schema guidance at an existing path or absent final property, with explicit completeness limits.
